description: This file defines types and utility functions related to usage metrics for AI agents, including normalization, snapshot creation, and calculations of prompt tokens and session totals.

methods.name: makeZeroUsageSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a default AssistantUsageSnapshot with all counts set to zero.

methods.name: hasNonzeroUsage
methods.description: Checks if a given usage object has any non-zero, finite values.

methods.name: normalizeUsage
methods.description: Converts various raw usage representations into a normalized usage object with consistent fields.

methods.name: derivePromptTokens
methods.description: Calculates total prompt tokens from input, cache read, and cache write counts.

methods.name: deriveSessionTotalTokens
methods.description: Determines the total tokens for a session, optionally overridden by a prompt token count.
